name: herdr-status
title: Herdr Status
description: See which Herdr coding agents need input (blocked) or finished (done) — local and remote machines.
author: lukas

commands.name: status
commands.title: Herdr Agent Status
commands.subtitle: Herdr Status
commands.description: List all Herdr agents grouped by status: blocked, done, working, idle — including remote machines.

commands.name: attention
commands.title: Herdr Attention
commands.subtitle: Herdr Status
commands.description: Show a summary of agents needing attention (blocked / done).

preferences.name: herdrPath
preferences.title: Herdr binary
preferences.description: Path to the herdr binary, or 'herdr' to resolve from PATH. Falls back to ~/.local/bin/herdr.

preferences.name: refreshInterval
preferences.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
preferences.description: How often the status view re-queries herdr.
